label: 方向一：暗色加密标本
prompt:
Render a single high-fidelity DESKTOP WEBSITE HOMEPAGE design comp for "proof of cake", edge-to-edge landscape 1536x1024, with crisp readable typography, no browser frame, no device mockup, no desk. This is a niche onchain birthday art gifting product for crypto-native users. The visitor browses ONE artwork at a time, decides whether it resembles a friend, then sends it to the friend's .ai identity. This is a real interface comp, not a poster or a moodboard. Preserve clear working-screen affordances for next artwork, friend identity, and preparing a gift. Include exactly these Chinese functional texts where appropriate: "这个不像他，换一个", "朋友的 .ai 名字", "准备这份礼物", and small "设计预览，无真实交易". Use "Still here" as the sample artwork title and "生日艺术作品" as its description. No fake prices, ownership counts, trade statistics, transaction hashes, endorsements or claims of real login. Do not use cute characters, faces, mascots, cartoon cake illustrations, pink, candy colors, emoji, stock crypto coins, laser beams, glow-laden cyberpunk, or a card grid. The artwork should be a mature collectible computational birthday object: a material, sculptural candle, or a sophisticated coded sculpture with a birthday association.
Direction: cryptographic specimen. Matte carbon-black ground, chalk-white and aged silver; only a very restrained desaturated mineral-green signal on a functional control. The screen revolves around a large central unframed sculptural artifact: an intricate silver candle-knot, photographed as a serious experimental art object, faint computational mesh structure intersecting the actual sculpture. Its visual weight and negative space carry the page; quiet compact peripheral typography makes this feel like a private cryptographic art instrument. Place the next-artwork decision close to the art and make the recipient-and-gift action a concise anchored interface. The wordmark and wallet utility belong to the frame, discreetly. Strong independent art direction, distinct proportion, excellent typographic hierarchy. A visibly intentional internet-native product, without imitating a terminal or trading dashboard. One dominant composition, no conventional split hero, feature sections or rounded marketing cards.
scope: Homepage image direction only; not implemented frontend
